_readme: queue: topics not yet drafted, grouped by pillar. When the daily drafting routine picks one, it removes it from queue in the SAME commit as the draft file (single PR). used: appended when a PR merges (title/pillar read straight from the merged file's front-matter), with devto url + date. rejected: appended when a PR is closed without merging (title/pillar read from the closed PR's head commit via the GitHub API, since that content never lands on main), with any PR feedback text, so future drafts avoid the same miss. When a pillar's queue drops below 3 items, the daily drafting run generates 5 more for that pillar, checked against 'used' and 'rejected' titles before adding.
